title_zh: 小鳄鱼的糖果牙齿-孩子不爱刷牙，怎么办？
source_file: 小鳄鱼的糖果牙齿-孩子不爱刷牙，怎么办？(2-6 岁).pptx
full_text_zh:
[P1] 儿童行为习惯培养绘本
小鳄鱼的糖果牙齿
孩子不爱刷牙，怎么办？
王亚云 / 著  陆圣欣 / 绘
白玲美名
儿童文学作家
幼儿老师  推荐
河北少年儿童出版社
河北出版传媒集团

[P2] 聆听故事、培养品德

发现孩子有了行为偏差，家长谁不想立即加以导正。

但是用什么方法？这一套书设计的是“看图听故事”的方法——不打、不骂、不惩罚。

编者采用有趣的“图画故事”形式，为孩子讲一个故事，提供一种情境，
让孩子“在故事里走了一趟”以后，根据所见所闻，透过客观讨论，认识
行为对自己和对别人的影响。

这些故事只提供情境，跟一般的“说教故事”不同。

编者期待的是家长能善用这一套书，导正孩子的行为偏差——不仅是“导正”，更重要的是“建立”理性的行为标准。

我对编者的创意和用心，表达钦佩。

台湾著名儿童文学作家
林良

[P3] 小鳄鱼的牙齿
又大又白，亮
晶晶，什么东西他都咬得动，

[P4] 什么甜食他都
爱吃，一个接
一个，永远吃
不腻。

[P6] 巧克力、蛋糕、
饼干、糖果他都喜欢。
嗯，实在太好吃了！

[P7] 糖果虽然好吃，
但每次都要伸手拿，好麻烦哦！

[P8] 如果我有糖果牙齿，该有多好呀！

[P10] 小鳄鱼拿来了
糖果罐，
对着镜子，
高高兴兴地，
把糖果一颗
一颗装进了
嘴巴里。

[P12] “这个办法太棒了，只有我这么聪明的鳄鱼才想得到！”
小鳄鱼看着自己的糖果牙齿，心里好得意。

[P14] 从那一天起，小鳄鱼
每天都开心地舔着糖
果牙齿，吃一颗巧克
力、舔一口牛奶糖、
咬一块蛋糕，从早到
晚，吃个不停。

[P15] 花花绿绿的糖果牙齿
整天陪着他，
也跟着他一起睡觉、一起玩耍。

[P16] 有一天，可怕的事情发生了——
小鳄鱼的牙齿痛得不得了！

[P18] 鳄鱼爸爸立刻带小鳄鱼
去看牙医。
哇！只听到小鳄鱼惨叫一声……

[P19] 你还喜欢糖果牙齿吗，
小鳄鱼？

[P22] 小故事大启发
小鳄鱼什么都爱吃，尤其是甜食，越甜他越喜欢吃。有一天，他异想天开：如果把各式各样最爱的甜食都粘在牙齿上，想吃的时候就用长长的舌头舔一下、咬一口，不是非常方便吗？就这样，小鳄鱼把巧克力、糖果、蛋糕等喜爱的甜食都装上去了，早也舔，晚也舔。猜猜结果发生了什么事？
没错，小鳄鱼长蛀牙了！小鳄鱼的牙齿痛得要命，最后只好找牙医把牙齿一颗一颗地拔掉。经过这次的教训，小鳄鱼再也不敢吃那么多甜食了，更重要的是，现在每次吃完甜食以后，他都会好好清洁牙齿了。
许多家长为要小朋友刷牙而感到生气，因为小朋友总是不肯乖乖地刷牙，要小朋友刷牙，仿佛打了一场仗，把家长累坏了。其实我们可以借故事中小鳄鱼的例子说给小朋友听。爱吃甜食是小朋友的天性，想强迫他们不准吃是不可能的，倒不如把吃太多甜食和吃完甜食后不刷牙的后果告诉他们，让他们知道不刷牙就会像小鳄鱼一样，最后得去看牙医。如果能够适量吃甜食，而且吃完甜食后也能好好刷牙，就可以愉快地享受甜食的美味了
full_text_en:
[P1] Children's Behavior Habit Cultivation Picture Book
The Crocodile's Candy Teeth
What to do if children don't like brushing their teeth?
Wang Yanyun / Author  Lu Shengxin / Illustrator
Bai Lingmei
Children's Literature Writer
Recommended by kindergarten teachers
Hebei Children's Publishing House
Hebei Publishing Media Group

[P2] Listening to Stories, Cultivating Virtues

When children show behavioral problems, who wouldn't want parents to correct them immediately?

But what method should be used? This series is designed with the "picture-story listening" approach — no hitting, no scolding, no punishment.

The editors use an engaging "picture story" format to tell a story for children, providing a scenario. After children "take a journey through the story," they reflect on what they've seen and heard, and through objective discussion, understand how their behavior affects themselves and others.

These stories only provide scenarios, different from typical "didactic stories".

The editors hope parents will make good use of this series to correct children's behavioral issues — not just to "correct," but more importantly, to "establish" rational behavioral standards.

I express my admiration for the editors' creativity and dedication.

Famous Taiwanese children's literature writer
Lin Liang

[P3] The little crocodile's teeth
are big and white, shiny and bright,
he can bite anything.

[P4] He loves all kinds of sweets,
eating one after another,
never getting tired of them.

[P6] Chocolate, cakes,
cookies, candies—he likes them all.
Mmm, they're so delicious!

[P7] Candies are delicious,
but it's so troublesome to reach for them every time!

[P8] If I had candy teeth, how wonderful that would be!

[P10] The little crocodile brought the candy jar,
Faced the mirror,
Happily,
Put one candy,
One by one,
Into his mouth.

[P12] "This idea is brilliant! Only a clever crocodile like me could think of it!"
Little crocodile looked at his candy teeth and felt very proud.

[P14] From that day on, the little crocodile
happily licked his candy teeth every day,
eating a piece of chocolate,
licking a milk candy,
biting a piece of cake,
from morning till night, never stopping.

[P15] The colorful candy teeth
stay with him all day,
and also sleep and play with him.

[P16] One day, something terrible happened—
the little crocodile's teeth hurt terribly!

[P18] The crocodile dad immediately took the little crocodile
 to see the dentist.
 Wow! All we heard was the little crocodile screaming...

[P19] Do you still like candy teeth, little crocodile?

[P22] Little Story, Big Inspiration
The little crocodile loves to eat everything, especially sweets—the sweeter, the better. One day, he had a wild idea: what if he stuck all his favorite sweets onto his teeth? Then, whenever he wanted to eat, he could just lick them with his long tongue or bite into them. Wouldn’t that be super convenient? So, the little crocodile loaded his teeth with chocolate, candies, cakes, and other sweets, licking them morning and night. Can you guess what happened next?
Well, the little crocodile got cavities! His teeth hurt so badly that he had to go to the dentist and have each tooth pulled out one by one. After this lesson, the little crocodile never dared to eat so many sweets again. More importantly, now every time he finishes eating sweets, he makes sure to clean his teeth properly.
Many parents get frustrated trying to get their children to brush their teeth, because kids often refuse to brush. Getting them to brush feels like a battle, exhausting the parents. In fact, we can use the example of the little crocodile from this story to teach children. Loving sweets is natural for kids, and forcing them to stop eating them is impossible. Instead, we can tell them about the consequences of eating too many sweets and not brushing afterward, so they understand that not brushing will lead to the same fate as the little crocodile—ending up at the dentist. If they eat sweets in moderation and brush their teeth after eating, they can enjoy the delicious taste of sweets happily.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《小鳄鱼的糖果牙齿》的封面，展示了书名、作者、绘者、出版社信息以及一个躺在红色床单上的绿色小鳄鱼形象，周围散落着各种糖果和甜点，主题聚焦于儿童不爱刷牙的问题。
[P2] 本页为绘本的推荐语页面，由台湾著名儿童文学作家林良撰写，介绍了该系列绘本通过‘看图听故事’的方式，帮助孩子认识行为影响，培养品德，强调家长应引导孩子建立理性行为标准，而非简单惩罚。
[P3] 本页描绘了小鳄鱼拥有又大又白、亮晶晶的牙齿，能够咬动任何东西，画面中展示了糖果、巧克力等食物，暗示其饮食习惯。
[P4] 本页描绘了小鳄鱼对甜食的极度喜爱，文字说明他什么都爱吃，永远吃不腻，画面中展示了各种糖果、巧克力等甜食飞向张开大嘴的小鳄鱼。
[P5] 本页为绘本《小鳄鱼的糖果牙齿》的插图页面，画面中一只绿色小鳄鱼张开大嘴，露出又大又白的牙齿，口中飞出五彩糖果和甜点，表现出其对甜食的极度喜爱和享受，延续前文对小鳄鱼爱吃甜食的描绘。
[P6] 本页描绘了小鳄鱼对巧克力、蛋糕、饼干和糖果等甜食的喜爱，画面中各种甜点飞向张开大嘴的小鳄鱼，文字表达了他对甜食的享受。
[P7] 小鳄鱼躺在红色枕头上，嘴里含着棒棒糖，文字表达了他对糖果的喜爱，但也觉得每次伸手拿糖很麻烦。
[P8] 小鳄鱼躺在红色枕头上，嘴里含着棒棒糖，心想如果自己有糖果牙齿该有多好，表达了他对糖果的渴望和对现有牙齿的不满。
[P9] 本页为绘本插图，画面中一只绿色小鳄鱼张开大嘴，露出又大又白的牙齿，口中和牙缝间塞满了巧克力、糖果、彩虹糖等甜食，表现出其对甜食的极度喜爱和享受，延续前文对小鳄鱼爱吃甜食的描绘。
[P10] 小鳄鱼拿着糖果罐，对着镜子，开心地将糖果一颗颗装进嘴里，表现出他对甜食的享受和满足。
[P11] 画面中一只绿色小鳄鱼的头部特写，它的眼睛里映出彩色糖果的倒影，背景为红色带有玫瑰花纹的枕头，表现出小鳄鱼对甜食的向往和喜爱。
[P12] 小鳄鱼对自己的糖果牙齿感到非常得意，认为这是只有聪明的自己才能想到的妙招。
[P13] 画面中一只绿色小鳄鱼的侧面和尾巴，它穿着橙色上衣和蓝色裤子，尾巴上系着橙色带子，背景为黑色，表情满足，似乎在享受甜食带来的快乐。
[P14] 小鳄鱼从那天起每天都开心地用糖果牙齿吃各种甜食，从早到晚不停歇，表现出他对甜食的极度享受。
[P15] 小鳄鱼的糖果牙齿整天陪伴着他，一起睡觉、一起玩耍，表现出他对糖果牙齿的喜爱和满足。
[P16] 小鳄鱼因为吃太多甜食，牙齿开始剧烈疼痛，画面中它捂着脸、满头大汗，表现出极度的痛苦。
[P17] 画面中，一颗拟人化的牙齿表情痛苦，周围散落着各种糖果，暗示小鳄鱼因吃太多甜食导致牙齿疼痛，糖果牙齿也因过度使用而感到不适。
[P18] 鳄鱼爸爸带小鳄鱼去看牙医，小鳄鱼因牙痛发出惨叫。
[P19] 一只小鸟站在巨大的白色牙齿上，问小鳄鱼是否还喜欢糖果牙齿，暗示小鳄鱼的牙齿问题可能已解决。
[P20] 画面中，一只绿色的小鳄鱼正抱着一个巨大的白色牙齿，脸上挂着汗珠，表情痛苦，似乎在经历牙痛的折磨。背景为橙白相间的锯齿状图案，突显其不适感。
[P21] 画面中，一只绿色小鳄鱼穿着橙色上衣和蓝色裤子，张开大嘴，嘴里塞满了各种糖果和甜点，表情满足，似乎在享受甜食带来的快乐。背景为白色，右下角有一个带有云朵图案的圆形物体。
[P22] 本页为绘本的总结与启发部分，讲述了小鳄鱼因贪吃甜食导致蛀牙并拔牙的后果，强调了吃完甜食后刷牙的重要性，并建议家长通过故事引导孩子养成良好的口腔卫生习惯。
